jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager within Process Automation at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Does the idea of being part of the largest pharmaceutical projects in Denmark and managing complex Process Automation projects excite you? And do you thrive on defining and executing project strategies in close corporation with highly skilled colleagues? Then you’ll fit right in!

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**As a Senior Project Manager within Process Automation, you will be part of our large project portfolio in Kalundborg. You will play an important role in ensuring the successful execution of our deliveries and will be in close contact with both internal and external stakeholders.

As part of your role, you will maintain close dialogue with your team on-site and participate in regular meetings across disciplines, ensuring transparency, efficiency, and execution according to our plans.

The technical focus of this position is Process Automation, working with DCS 800xA and ECS solutions interfacing with new technologies within the Industry 4.0 domain and Manufacturing IT solutions. Our projects cover the entire project lifecycle, from conceptual and basic design phases to on-site testing activities, including FAT, Interface Testing, Wet Testing, SAT, and UAT, culminating in handover to our customers.

Based on your skills and experience, several opportunities are available within our portfolio.

Location Denmark - Kalundborg

Experience Minimum 5 Years

Department AIT Project Management

**How You Might Spend Your Days

**As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for:

• Executing projects within your area in close collaboration with your team, identifying risks and implementing mitigation measures.

• Focusing on overall project planning, ensuring delivery quality, and planning the necessary resources to maintain schedule and cost targets.

• Estimating costs and planning budgets in collaboration with our engineers and specialists.

• Managing project scope and ensuring that changes are analysed and agreed upon with stakeholders.

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:

• Work across the boundaries and you like to work in a diverse and international environment

• Create results through efficient project management and communication, leveraging from your relations to your team and stakeholder

• Have a personal commitment, known for your effectiveness and an open management style and know the impotency to win as a team

• Are fluent in English both written and spoken

**What You Bring To The Role

**To be successful in this role, we expect you to have the following experience and educational background:

• An educational background at bachelor's level or a similar relevant technical background.

• 6–10 years of experience with a proven track record in DCS and ECS/PLC Process Automation projects, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.

• Experience with GMP project execution and preferable knowledge with S88 and S95

• Experience in executing Process Automation projects in collaboration with other disciplines, such as mechanical and process design, as well as end users.

• Experience with on-site commissioning activities, including FAT, SAT, and UAT.

• Project Management certification, e.g. PMP or PRINCE2, is preferred.

If you do not meet all the requirements, you are still welcome to apply and provide alternative experience that you believe would be valuable in this role.

Life at NNE NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, it means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer **here .

****Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

****Deadline of application is 1st November 2026

**Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Søren Frisenborg Marker on +45 3191 8696

**Please note:

**

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

**Fair hiring:

**At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

jobs.occupation: Senior AI Engineer for The Tech Collective
jobs.description:
We're looking for a senior AI engineer with hands-on experience in generative AI, API integrations, and advanced agent-based applications. The ideal candidate brings a mix of full-stack, AI, and cloud engineering experience.

**What You'll Do

**This role cuts across multiple tech stacks and is a central part of how we deliver AI solutions for our clients.

**In This Role, You'll

**

• Translating early ideas into working prototypes and iterating them into production-ready solutions using modern full-stack frameworks

• Designing and deploying generative AI applications and autonomous agents using LLM APIs and established agent frameworks

• Integrating AI capabilities into client systems and managing deployment pipelines in cloud environments

• Collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to build solutions that address real needs

• Mentoring junior engineers and keeping pace with emerging AI and software engineering paradigms

**What You'll Bring

**We're looking for someone with at least five years of software development experience, including at least two in generative AI and agent-based applications, and a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

**Beyond That, You'll Bring

**

• Full-stack capability across TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vite) and Python, with experience shipping production systems

• Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, Agno, or DSPy

• Proficiency with RESTful APIs, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and containerisation tools such as Docker and Kubernetes

• Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus. English is our corporate language; however, proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus for this role.

**What We Offer

**You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**About The Tech Collective

**The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI and analytics, ensuring that they are fit for the digital future. Through co-creation and passionate advisory, we aim to make our clients’ data easy to handle and provide useful insights.

In our collective, you will find people with a combination of nerdiness and infectious energy. We are passionate about technology, but we also have a sincere interest in people.

jobs.occupation: Lead Developer to support the Green Energy Transition
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced developer interested in building high-quality software and contributing to critical applications that support the efficient, reliable, and secure operation of the Nordic power grid? If you are looking to make an impact in supporting the green transition of the energy sector across Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark, you might be the person we are looking for.

Join a fast-developing Nordic company and become a part of an agile environment, where we develop innovative solutions. Nordic RCC is an important contributor to the green energy transition, supporting the Nordic transmission system operators in ensuring efficient and secure operations of the Nordic electricity power system.

As part of our continued growth, Application Development is expanding significantly. We are strengthening our department with two Lead Developers and five Senior Developers, creating exciting opportunities to join a growing team and help shape the future of software development at Nordic RCC.

Your role

As a Lead Developer in Application Development, you will join a collaborative department of approximately 23 developers who design, develop and maintain the internal applications supporting our current and future business services. If you are curious about Nordic RCC and what we do, learn more about our innovative solutions on the Nordic RCC webpage.

Your role combines hands-on development with broader technical leadership. You will work closely with Application Architects to help define and communicate technical direction, translate architectural principles into practical solutions and promote consistency across our application landscape.

You will connect technical expertise across teams, identify shared challenges, and contribute to reusable, sustainable solutions. Through cross-departmental collaboration, you will build alignment around technical opportunities, constraints, and impacts across the organization.

What you will do :

• 
Design, develop, and maintain robust applications using C# and .NET, while promoting consistent standards, code quality, maintainability and operational stability

• 
Contribute to improving system architecture by identifying areas for technical refinement, refactoring, or modernization

• 
Collaborating across the organization, represent Application Development by collaborating with Product Owners, Delivery Management, testers, Quality Management and other departments

• 
Set and communicate technical direction with Application Architects, translating architectural principles and business needs into practical solutions and Architecture Decision Records

• 
Connect technical expertise across teams and applications, enabling collaboration on dependencies, common challenges and reusable solutions

• 
Support operational excellence by helping diagnose and resolve production issues and continuously optimize existing systems

• 
Share knowledge and technical expertise supporting colleagues’ professional development and help strengthen development practices across the team. This role does not include formal line-management responsibilities

Technology Stack:

• 
Primary languages and frameworks  C#, .NET, SolidJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Functional programming, Python

• 
Architecture, design patterns & integrations  Clean Architecture, SOLID, Event-driven Architecture, Message-driven Architecture, REST APIs

• 
Databases & storage Relational databases (SQL Server), NoSQL databases (MongoDB), GridFS, S3

• 
Infrastructure & Platform (on-prem)  Kubernetes (on-prem), Docker, Rancher, Prometheus/Grafana, ArgoCD, NginX

• 
Tooling and collaboration  Git, Visual Studio, VS Code, JetBrains Rider, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines

We’re looking for someone with:

• 
Collaborative Attitude: You will be working closely with our team of Application Architects, shaping architectural decisions for supporting maintainable, scalable and robust systems

• 
Technical Foundation: A degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field

• 
Proven Expertise: Minimum 5 years’ experience as full-stack developer in C# for the .NET platform. Experience providing technical guidance, facilitating technical decisions, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating development activities is a definite plus.

• 
Nice to have: Experience working with functional programming, Clean Architecture principles, Azure DevOps, Kubernetes and Scrum processes

• 
Energy Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with the power systems domain is a plus but not required

If you do not tick all the boxes, but think you could be a good match, don’t hesitate to apply for this position.

What We Offer: A Flexible and Inclusive Workplace

You will join a diverse organization of 23 nationalities, where inclusivity is celebrated, with more than 30% women on board (and a commitment to improving this balance). We are located in Copenhagen Towers office in Ørestad, with the flexibility to balance on-site and remote work 2 days a week.

At Nordic RCC, we live by the values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency—values defined by our employees that shape how we collaborate and innovate. If you see yourself thriving in such an environment, we’d love to hear from you.

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online (in English) no later than 15/11-2026. Interviews will be held on a rolling basis up until the right candidate has been found.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

If you have any questions, please contact Pernille Yde Juul Hansen, Manager, Application Development pyh@nordic-rcc.net / +45 3092 3111.

Are you a recent or upcoming graduate interested in making an impact? Become part of a global and successful MedTech company located in the heart of Copenhagen.

Join Orifarm as our new RA Specialist and play a key role in managing regulatory variations, contributing to CMC strategies, and acting as a trusted regulatory partner

About the job

This position is a parental cover, expected to run for approximately a year. You can be based in Odense or Søborg, Denmark, or in Warsaw, Poland.

As our RA Specialist you will be responsible for ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements during the lifecycle management of Orifarm’s marketing authorisations. The role involves developing and executing regulatory affairs strategies, preparation of regulatory variation packages as well as authoring the CMC part of the regulatory dossiers.

The position requires a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, analytical testing and pharmaceutical legislation and guidelines, coupled with strong communication skills.

As our RA Specialist you will collaborate closely with colleagues across functions, such as chemists, formulation specialists and co-workers within Quality, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and Sales to ensure variations are managed in due time to ensure uninterrupted supply of our medicines to patients.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

• 
Develop and implement regulatory strategies for variations related to the CMC sections of dossiers to ensure regulatory compliance

• 
Stay updated with current regulatory legislation, guidelines and best practices related to CMC

• 
Provide regulatory guidance and support to cross-functional project teams

• 
Coordinate and compile required documentation, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with regulatory requirements

• 
Review and assess manufacturing changes, analytical methods, and process validations to ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines

• 
Prepare and review CMC sections of regulatory dossiers and variation packages

• 
Manage timelines and ensure timely submission of regulatory variation packages

• 
Act as the primary contact for competent authorities and prepare responses to regulatory questions

• 
Facilitate communication with regulatory authorities to resolve issues and obtain necessary approvals

• 
Daily operations tasks: Change controls, variations, input to deviations, RA Input to Product Quality Reports (PQR) and support to Regulatory Compliance Files (RCF)

Who are you?

We imagine that you have:

• An advanced degree (master’s or PhD) in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or a related field

• At least 3 years of experience from a similar RA position at HQ level

• A solid understanding of GMP, development and commercial activities

• Knowledge of European regulatory requirements, submission processes and interactions with regulatory authorities throughout Europe, especially the Nordic countries where the majority of our products are registered

• A solid understanding of global regulatory legislation and guidelines

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in fluent English

• Stakeholder management skills to foster strong working relationships with internal teams, external partners and competent authorities

• Excellent interpersonal skills to manage and resolve issues efficiently

• A high level of accuracy and attention to detail in all aspects of work

Who are we?

We are two teams of skilled and dedicated regulatory professionals located in Odense, Søborg and Warsaw. We value a relaxed, positive, and humorous atmosphere, where there is room for both laughter and focus. Our working environment is dynamic and engaging, characterized by a strong sense of ownership and collaboration. Everyone takes responsibility for their own tasks while actively supporting and sparring with colleagues, both professionally and personally.

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are 2,300 employees united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Application deadline

As soon as possible. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Job Description

How does Europe reap the benefits of AI, while remaining secure, sovereign and true to its democratic values? These are some of the questions that Netcompany Institute has set out to answer, and we are looking for two student assistants to help us do just that.

Netcompany Institute is a new analytical unit providing data-driven analyses of how AI and digitalization affect Europe. The aim is to strengthen the evidence base for public debate and help decision-makers navigate the choices that will shape Europe’s digital future.  You'll join a small team: a Chief Economist and two full-time Analytics Consultants.

Responsibilities

You will support analyses throughout their lifecycle – from framing questions to communicating results. Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Monitor policy developments and research on AI and digitalisation in Europe

• Collect and structure data from Eurostat, OECD and statistical offices

• Produce descriptive statistics, tables and charts publication-ready

• Write analytical text and fact-check sources

Responsibility grows with experience. At the beginning you will work closely with an Analytics Consultant on clearly defined tasks; over time we expect you to take ownership of analyses in your own right.

How we work with AI

AI tools are integral to our work. We use them for literature searches, data work and monitoring – so human time focuses on what matters most: finding the right questions, interpreting results and communicating them clearly. We are looking for two students who can each work approximately 16 hours per week. We are flexible during exam periods, but availability is expected in the lead-up to publication deadlines and events. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are curious about how AI and digitalisation are changing European economies and societies

The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Are you studying law and curious about how legal work is applied in a global shipping company? Would you like to gain hands-on experience with claims, contracts, legal research, and commercial problem-solving? And does working with 30+ nationalities in a truly global company sound appealing to you? If yes, then we are looking for you to be our new colleague!

What you will be doing

We are looking for a motivated Student Assistant to join our Legal & Claims team in Gentofte. You will work closely with Jens Erik, Glenn and Eirik and support them on a broad range of legal and claims-related matters across our global business.

The role is broad combining practical support with legal analysis and research, and your tasks will vary depending on what is happening in the business. Some assignments will be routine and process-oriented, while others will give you the opportunity to dive into legal questions, contracts and claims matters. We will make sure you get insight into different parts of the Legal & Claims function, while also contributing to the practical work that keeps things moving.

Among other interesting tasks, you will be:

• Assisting with legal research within shipping and maritime law and related areas

• Drafting and reviewing clauses, contracts and other legal documents

• Supporting claims handling and helping with smaller legal matters and disputes

• Helping us build structure and overview around external lawyers, arbitrators and recurring claims processes

• Supporting practical processes such as maritime insurance invoices and documentation

• Preparing presentations, internal updates and legal knowledge-sharing material

• Participating in meetings with external lawyers and advisors

• Supporting ad hoc matters within areas such as corporate law, M&A and commercial contracts

We offer a flexible working week of 2-3 days, with more hours required during holiday periods and fewer hours during your exam periods.

What we would love about you

We are looking for a law student in the final year of their bachelor’s degree who is curious about how legal work comes to life in a global shipping company.

You will probably enjoy this role if you like an environment where many things are happening at once and priorities can change. You are structured, detail-oriented and comfortable following tasks through, whether you are helping with practical coordination or diving into legal research.

You do not need to know all ins and outs of maritime law from day one. We will introduce you properly to the tasks, the team and the business. What matters most is that you are eager to learn, take responsibility and want to develop. Previous experience from a law firm, a legal department or a related business area is an advantage, especially if it has given you exposure to transport, shipping, claims or commercial legal work.

We are looking for someone who:

• Is currently in the final year of their bachelor’s degree in law

• Has strong academic results and can attach an updated grade transcript

• Is curious about shipping, maritime law, claims and broader legal work

• Structured, detail-oriented, and able to initiate and finish tasks independently

• Is eager to learn and develop

• Appreciate working in a multicultural environment

• Communicates confidently in Danish and English

• Hold a residence and work permit allowing you to work in Denmark

Not meeting every single requirement? At Ultrabulk, we value a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t match every qualification. We believe the right candidate brings not only expertise and drive but also contributes positively to our culture, one built on strong teamwork and a welcoming, social atmosphere.

What you might love about us

We have a strong youth community with trainees, interns and student assistants. With more than 30 nationalities across 10 locations, you will step into a genuinely international, informal and social environment: the kind where people enjoy working together, not just working next to each other. _Are you passionate about digital commerce, strategic partnerships, and driving growth through leading online marketplaces? At Pandora, we're looking for a commercially driven Business Development Specialist, Digital Partners to join our Global eCommerce team!

_In this role, you will be responsible for developing and growing strategic digital partnerships, with an initial focus on scaling Pandora's collaboration with Zalando across Europe while helping shape the future of our broader Digital Partner strategy. You will work at the intersection of business development, partner management, commercial performance, and operational execution, collaborating with stakeholders across markets and functions to unlock new growth opportunities for the world's largest jewellery brand.

As Business Development Specialist, Digital Partners, you will play a key role in accelerating Pandora's growth across marketplaces, multi-brand platforms, and strategic digital partners.

You will own relationships with key partners, develop joint growth plans, identify new opportunities, and ensure strong commercial and operational performance across markets. The role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and offers significant exposure to senior stakeholders internally and externally.

**Key Responsibilities

**Drive Digital Partner Growth and Strategy

• Identify and evaluate opportunities to expand Pandora's presence across marketplaces and strategic digital partnerships

• Develop business cases and value propositions for new partner initiatives and market expansion opportunities

• Lead assessments of future operating models and growth opportunities that support incremental revenue while protecting brand equity and profitability

• Work closely with cluster and global stakeholders to ensure alignment between partner initiatives and broader commercial objectives

• Own market-level forecasting and commercial performance tracking, including sell-in, sell-out, profitability, marketing investments, and performance against approved business cases

Manage Strategic Partner Relationships

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key partners, including marketplaces, agencies, and strategic digital commerce providers

• Serve as the primary point of contact for commercial discussions, negotiations, issue resolution, and strategic alignment

• Develop and execute joint business plans that drive mutual growth and long-term partnership success

• Monitor partner performance against revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and operational KPIs

• Lead weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews with clear actions, ownership, timelines, and escalation plans

Deliver Market Intelligence and Commercial Insights

• Monitor digital commerce trends, marketplace developments, competitor activity, and emerging partnership models

• Analyse customer acquisition trends, commercial performance metrics, and market opportunities to inform recommendations

• Develop frameworks and reporting tools that enable data-driven decision making

• Stay ahead of industry developments and translate insights into actionable opportunities for Pandora

Lead Cross-Functional Execution and Operational Excellence

• Drive launch readiness for new partner initiatives across markets

• Coordinate assortment planning, inventory management, fulfilment, content deployment, reporting, and issue resolution activities

• Collaborate with Commercial, Merchandising, Operations, Technology, Marketing, Finance, and Legal stakeholders to ensure successful execution

• Work closely with technical teams on partner integrations and data flows between Pandora and partner platforms

• Support operational optimization initiatives that improve performance, efficiency, and scalability

Influence and Collaborate Across the Organization

• Act as the key link between global teams, regional clusters, and external partners

• Prepare executive updates, business reviews, and strategic recommendations for senior leadership

• Communicate risks, opportunities, and performance insights in a clear and compelling way

• Support and coach cluster stakeholders on best practices for managing and growing digital partner relationships

**What We Are Looking For

**You are commercially minded, relationship-oriented, and motivated by identifying opportunities that create long-term value. You enjoy navigating complexity, building alignment across stakeholders, and balancing strategic thinking with operational execution.

You are proactive, collaborative, and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and growth opportunities emerge quickly.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• 4+ years of experience within Business Development, E-commerce, Marketplace Management, Commercial Strategy, Digital Partnerships, or a similar commercial role

• Proven experience managing partner relationships and driving commercial growth

• Strong commercial acumen and the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations

• Experience working in cross-functional and international environments

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience engaging with senior decision-makers

• Professional proficiency in English

Experience from fashion, jewellery, consumer goods, retail, marketplaces, or digital commerce environments will be a significant advantage.

**Your new team

**As part of Pandora's Global eCommerce organization, you will join a team shaping the future of digital growth for the world's largest jewellery brand.

The Digital Partners team is responsible for accelerating Pandora's growth through marketplaces, multi-brand retailers, social commerce, online presence of distributors and other strategic digital partnerships.

Additional information

• Global Career Band: 5B

Did we get your attention? If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

About Pandora Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

jobs.description:
**Job Description

**_Start your analyst career in investment management with our Manager Selection Team, where you will work with leading global asset managers and develop expertise across diverse asset classes. You will be part of a collaborative environment that offers significant learning opportunities and career progression. This role provides the foundation for building specialised knowledge in investment strategy and portfolio management.

_But first, who are we at Danske Bank?   Danske Bank, the largest bank in Denmark, serves a diverse range of customers from individuals and businesses to large institutional clients. At Danske Bank, we create an environment where creativity and strategic thinking are central to all our activities.

LC&I business unit supports Danske Banks’ most sophisticated customers across the Nordics with their financing and transaction needs. Our experts across areas such as Corporate Finance, Markets, Transaction banking, Asset Management and Investor Services – are highly skilled and engage with our customers on some of the most complex transactions in the Nordics.

**What You Will Be Doing

**Join the Manager Selection Team at Danske Bank Asset Management. The team is responsible for identifying, selecting and monitoring asset managers and investment funds used across Danske Bank's investment platform. You will collaborate with portfolio managers and analysts to deliver multi-asset portfolio solutions. Working closely with internal teams and external partners, you will contribute to strategic decisions that shape our investment products and client outcomes.

• Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses of portfolio management teams and investment strategies

• Support manager searches, due diligence reviews and investment recommendation processes on internal and external opportunities

• Monitor performance, risk and key investment characteristics across various asset classes and investment products

• Contribute to the design and management of asset class specific investment strategies

• Collaborate with portfolio managers and analysts on multi-asset solutions

**About You

**

• Academic background in investment analysis, finance, economics, or related field

• Analytical mindset with structured approach to problem-solving

• Strong collaborative skills and ability to work with diverse stakeholders

• Interest in financial markets and investment management

• Clear communication skills for internal and external interactions

It would be beneficial if you have some exposure to financial analysis or investment concepts, though we welcome candidates who bring diverse perspectives to learn and develop in this area.

**What We Offer You

**Join our First Year Analyst programme, which includes dedicated sessions and social events to ease your transition into our culture and operations. You will build valuable connections across the organisation while developing both personally and professionally. Furthermore, we provide substantial learning opportunities where you will acquire specialised knowledge in investment strategy, asset allocation, and manager selection.

You will work in our Copenhagen office with a hybrid model of 3 to 4 days per week to support collaboration and knowledge sharing. As Manager Selection is a strategic focus area, you will gradually take on more responsibility as the business develops and grows.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**We would love to hear from candidates who are ready to develop their career in investment management. Please reach out to Torben Badsberg Overgaard, Head of Manager Selection, at toov@danskebank.dk or Carla Carlotta Zoe Steuer, Senior Portfolio Manager with any questions.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We're looking forward to exploring the possibilities with you! Starting a career at Danske Bank means joining a collaborative environment where you can engage actively from day one. As a full-time employee, you will be part of our Young Minds community, designed to help you grow personally and professionally through development sessions and social events with your peers. If you are looking for a rewarding and interesting opportunity, apply now and become part of our team! #YP

**About Us

**Danske Bank is a Nordic bank with bridges to the world around us. For 150 years, we have supported people and businesses in releasing their potential. A career with us is an opportunity to join a community of 22,000 colleagues in a culture where we are committed to Teaming Up, Owning It and Being Open. Together, we are on a journey to transform Danske Bank into a better bank. For our customers, our employees and the societies around us.

Would you enjoy leading drug development for rare conditions? Are you a medic with experience designing clinical trials and interacting with regulatory authorities?

_If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Medical Director, Clinical Development, Endocrine & Rare Diseases

_

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking an energetic and passionate Medical Director to join our team. As a member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in driving the design, safety monitoring, and data analysis within the Endocrine and Rare Disease Medical Sciences area. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will join the Clinical Development team, being part of the Endocrine & Rare Disease Medical Sciences organization. You will report directly to the VP of Clinical Science who is based in the US. You will be based in Hellerup together with the Danish team.

Since you will join a team based in different time zones, you must be available for evening meetings. This position also may require occasional international travel.

Your key responsibilities will be

• Contribute to formulation and implementation of the Clinical Development Plan

• Leverage medical expertise and hands-on clinical experience to promote relevance and rigor of the development program

• For clinical trials: design, provide overall oversight, and support site and subject retention

• Serve as a Medical Monitor for clinical trials, ensure study integrity, and track accumulating safety and efficacy data

• Provide leadership to teams of medical monitors and study teams

• Ensure successful completion of trial-related documents (including clinical trial protocols, investigator brochures, medical monitoring plans, site training materials, clinical study reports, health authority responses, standard operating procedures, etc.) with cross-functional team members

• Ensure study integrity, and track accumulating safety and efficacy data

• Analyze, evaluate, interpret, and report clinical data

• Anticipate and solve complex drug development problems

• Contribute to regulatory strategy

• Contribute to drafting and reviewing of clinical documents, manuscripts, presentations, and regulatory submissions

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of relevant science, medical information, good clinical practices, and regulatory guidance

• Collaborate with—and serve as a clinical research resource for—cross-functional colleagues (e.g. in clinical operations, statistics, regulatory affairs, medical affairs, health economics outcomes research, commercial, finance) to optimize product development

• Contribute to (and may be asked to represent the clinical development department in) corporate strategic and organizational initiatives

• Cultivate relationships with investigative sites, clinical consultants, and key opinion leaders to represent the interests of the company

• Assist in portfolio management and commercial activities as needed

• Complete assigned tasks thoroughly, accurately, and on time

• Adhere to rigorous ethical standards

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold an M.D. degree and preferably also a Ph.D. degree. You have hands-on experience treating patients.

Furthermore, you have:

• At least 5-7 years of industry experience (other relevant experience e.g., post-graduate experience in the clinical and/or academic realms may also be considered on a case-by-case basis).

• Strong track record of scientific and clinical inquiry

• Possess excellent communication skills (written and oral)

• Demonstrate sound judgement in terms of handling complex, confidential, and regulated information

Key competencies:

You have a proven ability to learn quickly, even in fast‑paced environments.

You take ownership of your work, lead by example, and collaborate effectively with colleagues across the organization. You are trusted by others for your sound judgment and discretion, particularly when handling confidential, sensitive, or regulated information.

To succeed in the position, we expect you to be comfortable working with complex instructions, managing multiple priorities, and consistently maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

Travel: 20-30 days per year

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup, Denmark

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.
